mechanism.claim: When quote-turnover participation expands broadly across six liquid alt perpetuals relative to each asset's own history, a high-variation BTC move confirmed by cross-alt return breadth reflects market-wide risk transfer rather than a narrow BTC print. Follow the completed BTC direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed BTC eight-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: CATDCR's primary object is the entropy of six per-symbol self-normalized quote-turnover allocations. Cross-alt price candidates use return breadth, residuals, or beta; flow candidates use taker direction; ticket and impact candidates use per-execution size or return per notional. CLD-72 used residual-return HHI transition, leader decline, and taker-flow alignment on a six-hour clock, not turnover-allocation entropy. No prior event set or control is reused.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed BTC block variation must be in its causal upper 35%, while broad turnover diffusion identifies risk capital active across the crypto complex; causal RV20 q90 remains only a post-stage audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three conditional eight-hour boundaries driven by six-alt turnover allocation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: exact 480 unique coherent bars_binance 1m rows [D-8h,D) for all seven symbols at D in 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC; no imputation
features.quote_turnover: sum quote_asset_volume for each alt over the completed block, finite and strictly positive
features.self_normalized_turnover: current alt quote turnover divided by that symbol's median over at most 270 strictly prior valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded
features.turnover_allocation: each of six positive self-normalized turnovers divided by their cross-sectional sum
features.turnover_entropy: negative sum share*log(share), divided by log(6), finite in (0,1]
features.diffusion_rank: strict-prior midrank of turnover entropy over at most 270 prior jointly valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.returns: log(last close/first open) independently for all seven symbols; nonzero BTC
features.alt_return_breadth: at least four of six strict nonzero alt return signs equal the BTC return sign
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open)) over the completed BTC block
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 prior valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.source_valid: finite positive coherent OHLC, finite nonnegative quote volume, exact unique minute grids for all symbols; no imputation

clock.decision: daily 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC after the exact block completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economic stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-sectional turnover-allocation diffusion mechanism plus user-required volatile-market focus

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no entropy definition, rank, breadth, variation, side, hold, clock, universe, subset, or control repair
